name: Sasayama Castle
description: Sasayama Castle was built 1609 by Tokugawa Ieyasu to control western Japan. The 2000-reconstructed Oshoin palace hall and the castle's moats and earthen walls make it a rare castle with a restored palace interior.
notes: The Oshoin (¥500) is open daily; the grounds are free. Pair with the preserved Sasayama castle-town streets.
